description:
A contemporary luxury residential front entry photographed at standing eye level with a normal lens in a centered symmetrical composition facing the entry directly. The camera is at approximately five feet, level, capturing the full door and flanking wall surfaces in a wide, balanced view.

The building facade is clad in large-format pale limestone or travertine panel blocks with a smooth honed face and tight mortar joints — a refined, monolithic stone exterior in a cool cream-to-taupe tone. A projecting canopy overhang above the entry is surfaced in warm honey-toned horizontal timber planking — wide-plank natural cedar or teak — creating a warm contrast to the cool stone walls on either side.

The front door is a substantial slab door in warm medium-toned natural bamboo or elm wood — vertical grain, pale golden-brown — set within a black powder-coated steel door frame. A full-height narrow glass sidelight panel runs to the right of the door, allowing a glimpse of warm interior light through the entry. A vertical bar-style matte-black handle is mounted on the door.

Two concrete entry steps in smooth grey finish lead up from the approach path — large-format grey concrete or limestone pavers — to the covered entry threshold. A matte-black round planter with low grey-green herbs or succulents sits at the base of each door side on the steps, one on each side.

To the right of the entry, a multi-trunk olive tree with silvery-green foliage grows from a ground-level landscape planting, silhouetted against the deep blue-apricot dusk sky. The sky glows with residual sunset warmth at the horizon to the right.

Warm amber blooms of light from each side of the door illuminate the stone wall faces symmetrically, creating golden pools on the pale stone surface. The atmosphere is refined, architectural, and Californian-modern at dusk.
